title: Slack Escalation Message Schema
description: Schema for Slack Block Kit messages sent to Green Flag holder when tickets are escalated

channel.description: Slack channel ID or user ID for direct message

text.example: 🚨 Green Flag Ticket Needs Review: CASSINI-1234

blocks.description: Slack Block Kit blocks for rich formatting

examples.text: 🚨 Green Flag Ticket Needs Review: CASSINI-1234

text.text: *Title:* Need IAM permissions for my project

*Top Matches:*
1. `IAM Request` (65%) - Mentioned 'permissions' but unclear context
2. `CQL Request` (58%) - Mentioned 'query' but not Cortex-specific
3. `Empty S3 Bucket` (32%) - Mentioned 'S3' but not bucket-related

elements.text: Reporter: John Doe | Created: <!date^1706356800^{date_short_pretty} at {time}|2026-01-27 10:30 UTC>

enum: Follow-up detected on previously processed ticket
Shadow mode active - no responses posted

low_confidence.description: Sent when no canned response confidence exceeds 80%

text.text:
*Reason:* Low confidence - no clear match found

*Top Matches:*
1. `IAM Request` (65%)
2. `CQL Request` (58%)
3. `Empty S3 Bucket` (32%)

ambiguous_match.description: Sent when multiple responses have confidence within 10% of each other

text.text:
*Reason:* Ambiguous match - multiple responses equally likely

*Top Matches:*
1. `Cortex Bug` (78%)
2. `Cortex Feature Request` (76%)

*Recommendation:* Review ticket manually to determine correct response.

sensitive_data.description: Sent when sensitive keywords are detected in ticket content

text.text:
:warning: *Reason:* Sensitive data detected - keywords: `password`, `token`

*Action Required:* Review ticket immediately. Do not share sensitive information via Jira comments.

classification_timeout.description: Sent when LLM classification times out after 30 seconds

text.text:
:hourglass: *Reason:* Classification timeout (30s exceeded)

*System Status:* LLM service may be experiencing issues. Check monitoring dashboard.

follow_up.description: Sent when ticket is detected as follow-up to previously processed ticket

text.text:
*Reason:* Follow-up detected on previously processed ticket

*Previous Action:* Auto-responded with `IAM Request` on 2026-01-27 at 10:00 UTC

*Note:* System does not respond to follow-ups to avoid conversation loops.

kill_switch.description: Sent when automation is disabled via kill switch

text.text:
:octagonal_sign: *Reason:* Automation disabled (kill switch activated)

*Disabled By:* jane.smith@skyscanner.net at 2026-01-27 09:00 UTC
*Disable Reason:* High error rate detected (>5%)

*Action:* All tickets are being escalated until automation is re-enabled.
